mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_documents ( teacher_id, file_path ) VALUES ( #{teacherId}, #{filePath} )

INSERT INTO company_info ( teacher_id, company_name, registration_number, representative_name, company_phone, address, email ) VALUES ( #{teacher_id}, #{company_name}, #{registration_number}, #{representative_name}, #{company_phone}, #{address}, #{email} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
t.username as userId,
COALESCE(t.name, '테스용 사이트로 개인정보 삽입금지') as name,
COALESCE(t.email,'테스용 사이트로 개인정보 삽입금지') as email ,
COALESCE(t.phone,'테스용 사이트로 개인정보 삽입금지') as phone,
t.approved,
t.created_at,
td.status, -- 사업자 정보 ci.company_name, ci.registration_number, ci.representative_name, ci.company_phone, ci.email
FROM teacher as t INNER JOIN teacher_documents AS td
ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id
INNER JOIN company_info AS ci
ON t.teacher_id =ci.teacher_id
WHERE t.username=#{username}

SELECT
-- 평가된 내용 td.document_type, td.status, td.uploaded_at, td.reviewed_at, -- 평가자 정보 a.full_name, a.email, a.phone
FROM teacher_documents as td
LEFT JOIN admin as a
ON td.reviewer_id=a.admin_id
WHERE teacher_id = #{teacher_id};
